value.note: Mixed nuts roasted with honey, chili and salt, piled in gold dishes for the emperor's feast.
Thick sweet onion rings in buttermilk batter, fried crisp and salted for the truckers.
Sharp cheddar, crackers and apple slices on a board, kept well off the floor.
Crisp fries smothered in beef chili and melted cheddar, eaten by the dust.
Cinnamon crumb cake cut in warm squares, made for a long stakeout over coffee.
